name: Perfectionism
overview: Scripture reveals that no one on earth is completely righteous or without sin, highlighting human imperfection (Ecclesiastes 7:20). True perfection is not achieved through fleshly effort but through the Spirit and the sanctifying work of Christ, who has perfected believers by His one offering (Romans 8:1; Galatians 3:3; Hebrews 10:14). While believers are called to pursue spiritual maturity and self-control, as seen in James 3:2 and Philippians 3:12, ultimate perfection remains a continual process dependent on Christ’s grace rather than human achievement.
